title: Keeping performance traditions alive
text: Devi Lal Samar founded Bharatiya Lok Kala Mandal in 1952. The institution studies and presents folk traditions through collections, training and performance. Puppets, instruments, costumes and masks show how material objects support living arts. A museum visit and a theatre performance offer different ways to engage with that work; check their separate schedules.
